known_fact_audit.criterion: Primary plus every other Company region with unrest
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: An Invasion or Rebellion against a Company region triggers secondary Rebellions in every other Company region with unrest.

known_fact_audit.criterion: Primary first, Bombay/Madras/Bengal and Commander choice within Presidency
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: Resolve the primary Crisis first, then secondary regions in Bombay, Madras, Bengal Army order; within each Presidency, its Commander chooses the order of associated regions.

known_fact_audit.criterion: Normal primary ordinary strength plus target unrest; secondary only local unrest
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: A normal primary Crisis uses its normal Invasion or Rebellion attack strength plus unrest in the target; a primary Foreign Invasion uses only its ordinary attack die; every secondary Rebellion uses only the unrest cubes in that secondary region.

known_fact_audit.criterion: Military Affairs then Chairman fallback, substitutes gain/lose no trophies
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: If the Commander is vacant, Military Affairs acts in its stead without trophies; if both are vacant, the Chairman chooses without trophies.

known_fact_audit.criterion: Compulsory active exhaustion equal to strength or as many as possible; alliance one-use/no split across purposes
known_fact_audit.reader_quote: Exhaust active Army pieces equal to Crisis strength, or as many as possible; local alliances provide printed strength once and cannot be split among purposes.

known_fact_audit.criterion: Printed nonmatch means attack succeeds and Region Loss

known_fact_audit.source_quote: If the newly-exhausted pieces do not equal the strength of the Crisis, the Crisis succeeds. Perform the steps of Region Loss (page 29).
